primitive.relation: Pointwise equality of adjacency with del_es_rel G [set e] for every vertex set e, valid edge or not (GTBase.common.del_edge_set1); the cards are related by the identity isomorphism. The cross-name U11 companion of the single-edge-deletion family (A3), deferred there by consumer scope.

single-pair-deletion-section.note: U11's Section DelEdge (Variables G e): sde_rel x y = (x -- y) && ([set x; y] != e), sdel_edge = SGraph sde_sym sde_irrefl.

retained_proof_lemmas.note: sde_sym and sde_irrefl keep their names and statements and are re-proved from del_es_sym/del_es_irrefl. They are frozen verbatim in the Legacy Section as the opaque proof scaffolding of Legacy.sdel_edge; sdel_edge_proofs_compat relates the SGraph built from the frozen proofs to the one built from the live lemmas (an isomorphism of constructions, not an equality of proof terms).

deck_bridges.note: same_edge_deck_compat keeps the same bijection f of edge indices and composes each card isomorphism with the identity isomorphisms of its two cards (sdel_edge_diso), so every card keeps its multiplicity; no card is replaced by a set equality. The Kelly premise and the external Whitney/Greenwell statement keep the four-edge guard and the same-edge-deck hypothesis; both stay conditional.

upstream_audit.note: Upstream digraph.del_edge deletes one directed arc of a diGraph (U11's reason for its own name), and sgraph.del_edges e deletes every edge inside the vertex set e, which agrees with sdel_edge only for genuine edges (grounding_U11.sde_del_edges_rel keeps that hypothesis). del_edge_set G [set e], the A2/A3 canonical, is the single-pair deletion for every vertex set e.
